== Biography ==
Yeon was born in Los Angeles, California. He began playing ''League of Legends'' in 2014, when he was 13. In the middle of 2020, he joined [[100 Thieves Next]] to replace [[Auto]], who was role swapping to support. Alongside star prospects like [[Tenacity]] and [[Kenvi]], Yeon dominated the North American amateur circuit and earned a spot at [[NASG 2020]], where he was drafted onto [[Team Ocean Drake (NASG Team)|Team Ocean Drake]]. His team won the event. Afterward, Yeon joined [[Team Liquid Academy]]. He would remain on the team for the next two years, winning LCS Proving Grounds twice in 2022.

=== 2023 Season ===
After dominating the academy scene for the past year, Yeon was promoted to be the starting bot laner for [[Team Liquid]] as part of a fully Korean-speaking roster.

== Trivia ==
* His ID '''Yeon''' is based on his Korean name Sung Yeon-ho.
* Was extensively mentored by [[CoreJJ]] while on [[Team Liquid Academy]] before being promoted to the LCS roster.
* Speaks English and Korean.
* His favorite pro players are [[Viper (Park Do-hyeon)|Viper]] and [[Ruler]].
* Likes anime and manga, also likes '''[[wikipedia:en:The King's Avatar (2017 web series)|The King's Avatar]],''' which is the origin of his previous ID '''Aki no Ki'''

=== Individual Awards ===
* LCS Rookie of the Year (2023)
* LCS First All-Pro Team (2024 Summer)
* LTA Finals MVP (2025 Split 1)
